memories_or_initialization.description: 推断的无初始化单时钟存储器：memMod/memMod_dist 的 reg [width-1:0] mem[depth-1:0]（design.v:784,808）、shiftRegFIFO 的 mem[depth-1:0]（design.v:825）、multfix 的 q[CYCLES-1:0]（design.v:4578）、addfxp/subfxp 的 res 数组（design.v:4602,4624）；无 initial 块或 $readmem* 加载

hierarchy_attributes.description: 多处 // synthesis attribute 注释型属性：rom_style of ... is "distributed"/"block"（如 design.v:453,650,688,728,766,1007,1174）及 ram_style of mem is block/distributed（design.v:782,806），指定存储器映射风格

existing_sdc.basis: constraints/timing.sdc:1 为 create_clock [get_ports clk] -period 5；clk 是 dft_top 的输入端口（rtl/design.v:92），该 SDC 与本顶层端口匹配，适用

ports.name: clk
ports.basis: design.v:92 input clk；全设计 always @(posedge clk)（如 design.v:416,532）的时钟

ports.name: reset
ports.basis: design.v:92,533-537 if (reset==1) 复位状态；design.v:77 注释复位高有效

ports.name: next
ports.basis: design.v:92,207 数据流起始控制标志，assign next_0 = next 送入流水线

ports.name: next_out
ports.basis: design.v:91,208 assign next_out = next_18，输出流标志

ports.name: X0
ports.basis: design.v:94 input [15:0] X0，t0_0 = X0（design.v:199）进入数据处理链

clocks.name: clk
clocks.basis: design.v:92 顶层输入端口 clk；所有寄存逻辑均为 always @(posedge clk)（design.v:416,532,830,849 等），无分频/门控/生成时钟结构

resets.basis: design.v:533,563,589,850 等在 always @(posedge clk) 内以 if (reset==1) 同步采样复位，敏感列表无异步沿；design.v:77 注释复位高有效

io_clock_associations.basis: design.v:207,211 next_0 直接驱动各 stage 的 next 输入，被 posedge clk 寄存链采样
design.v:208,208 next_18 来自末级 rc79089/perm79087 内 posedge clk 移位链（design.v:4315）
design.v:199 X0 经 t0_0 进入 stage0，数据在 posedge clk 寄存（如 design.v:931-936）
design.v:201 同上，单时钟 clk 数据通路
design.v:200 Y0 = t18_0，来自 stage17 posedge clk 流水寄存器
